facts.fact: 答话把“I've eaten up”当成名字，追问时忽然意识到对方刚刚吃了什么——敲门格式被改成食人笑话
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? I’ve eaten up. I’ve eaten up who? You’ve eaten a WHAT?

facts.fact: Anita 连读成 “I need to use your toilet”
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Anita. Anita who? Anita use your toilet.

facts.fact: Cowsgo 被当成“牛会去（哪里）”，答案纠正成“牛只会哞”
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Cowsgo. Cowsgo who? No they don’t, cows go moo!

facts.fact: 控制狂不听对方把问题问完，自己抢着规定对方该说什么
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Control freak. Con–– Okay, now you say, ‘Control freak who?’

facts.fact: “Little old lady who” 听起来像约德尔调（yodel）的唱腔
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Little old lady. Little old lady who? I didn’t know you could yodel!

facts.fact: 对方要求“拼出来”，回答就是把 who 拼成字母
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Spell. Spell who? W-h-o.

facts.fact: Kanga 被当成袋鼠名字的前半截，答者纠正成完整单词
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Kanga. Kanga who? Actually, it’s kangaroo!

facts.fact: 香蕉连续七轮之后换成 Orange，谐音 “Aren’t you glad…”
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Banana. Banana who? Knock, knock. Who’s there? Banana. Banana who?

facts.fact: Cash 谐音 cashew（腰果），答者按“坚果”理解并拒绝
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Cash. Cash who? No thanks, I have a nut allergy.

facts.fact: 名字长到荒谬，提问者反被问住——格式在名字这一格失效
facts.anchor: Knock, knock. Who’s there? Persephone Twinkletoes McGinty. Persephone Twinkletoes McGinty who? You … you know multiple people named Persephone Twinkletoes McGinty?
